description: This PHP source file defines a class 'MailAttachmentMIME' that extends 'mimetype' to detect MIME types based on filename extension. It also includes the implementation of the 'mimetype' class with a comprehensive MIME type array. The file appears to be a utility for MIME type detection within the MailScanner module of a CRM system.
